title: Modular evaluation trial test
statement: For Boolean lists $Q$ and $R$, the trial test returns the Boolean result of comparing, via the binary arithmetic equality test, the modular evaluations of two encoded expressions. Each evaluation uses an encoding built from the extracted length data of $Q$, the list $R$, the fifth nested second component of $Q$, and, respectively, the first or second extracted generator from $Q$.
caveat: The encoding, modular evaluation, equality test, and extraction operations are not defined in the supplied context.
